claim: The joined Moonshine branch contributes exact assets to seven maintained frontier targets, with immediate computational work for detector equivalence and complexity, candidate bridges for defects/emulators/quotient scars, and only comparative adjacency to positivity and renormalization.

targets.asset: explicit scalar, projective and bosonization fibres plus the complete C23 x S4 insertion census proving scalar genus-one orientation exhaustion
targets.nextGate: compute a vector-valued/projective S4 action, relational multi-insertion record or order-23-twined genus-two sewing
targets.killTest: every candidate observable remains constant on the same detector-equivalence classes

targets.asset: order-23 noninvertible defect channel, order-46 2A/2B junction and ten-even-characteristic seam carrier
targets.nextGate: construct a twisted-twining and genus-two intertwiner transporting information beyond sector count
targets.killTest: matching defect indices coexist with incompatible orientation, multipliers or seam data

targets.asset: F_23^2 quadratic module with source-declared S and D_5 generators closing to Dic_11 of order 44
targets.nextGate: realize both generators with provenance-bearing controls and predict reachable and forbidden words
targets.killTest: the closure requires arbitrary universal controls and gives no source-specific restriction

targets.asset: information-retention no-goes and admissibility quotient examples
targets.nextGate: derive an inequality stronger than ordinary unitarity, analyticity, passivity and causality
targets.killTest: the proposed bound is a reparameterized standard positivity theorem

targets.nextGate: supply a physical three-scale carrier with direct-versus-staged pushforward errors
targets.killTest: the arrows are category changes without coarse-graining, uncertainty transport or scale semantics

targets.asset: finite certificates for Rule 60, discriminant forms, modular orbits, transition groups, sector counts and complete scalar centralizer-insertion exhaustion
targets.nextGate: attach existence, preparation, sampling, detection and verification costs to the smallest vector/projective centralizer calculation and later sewing
targets.killTest: an unrestricted VOA character table or exponential tomography is hidden as an oracle

targets.asset: central-sign, generator-orientation and centralizer-kernel quotient scars with explicit lost data
targets.nextGate: show that coherent oriented readout resolves a residue erased by scalar or projective readout
targets.killTest: the result depends on identifying the C2 quotient with the distinct D4-to-G2 triality quotient

rankedTranches.name: vector-valued or projective S4 centralizer action
rankedTranches.outcome: test whether a non-scalar centralizer representation retains the relations erased at the common 2A/2B/23 junction

rankedTranches.name: mixed-level genus-two modular intertwiner
rankedTranches.outcome: join or separate the level-23 orientation and ten-even-characteristic level-2 carriers without forcing a forbidden order-11 action on spin labels

rankedTranches.name: Dic_11 to D_11 quotient-scar emulator
rankedTranches.outcome: demonstrate coherent versus projective information retention in a conventional platform

rankedTranches.name: physical scale and real-Spin lift
rankedTranches.outcome: held until a source-native action, signature, time orientation and detector map exist

epistemicBoundary: membership in this crosswalk records relevance and distance, not evidence that the Moonshine carrier is realized in laboratory physics
